name: DisplaySelectFolderDialog
label: Display Select Folder Dialog
description: Displays a folder selection dialog to let users choose a folder.

fields.name: DialogDescription
fields.label: Dialog Description
fields.description: The description or title of the folder selection dialog window.

fields.name: InitialFolder
fields.label: Initial Folder
fields.description: The folder path where the dialog starts. If empty, defaults to Desktop.

fields.name: KeepDialogOnTop
fields.label: Keep Dialog On Top
fields.description: If true, keeps the dialog on top of all other windows.

fields.name: SelectedFolder
fields.label: Selected Folder
fields.description: The full path of the folder selected by the user.

fields.name: ButtonPressed
fields.label: Button Pressed
fields.description: True if user clicked OK; False if Cancel was clicked or dialog closed.
